notes: Medium. A reproducible provisioning pipeline: create two named venvs with a specified 3.12 interpreter, install a pinned auto-installed package plus a small package from a local offline index, upgrade a bundled data library from 1.4.0 to >= 2.0.0 to expose an absent keyword, generate gRPC bindings from a proto into the server venv and install a chain-query helper, wire a Jupyter notebook server config, and persist a requirements.lock matching the installed pins. dependent_stages=2 (venv creation -> package install -> bindings/lock; each stage feeds the next). hidden_case_generalization=2 because the verifier re-runs provision.sh from four genuinely different pre-existing filesystem states (absent, partial, stale-downgraded, corrupt) that a robust idempotent script must recover from. adversarial_inputs=1 (stale and corrupt seeds). debugging_ambiguity=1 (interpreter/locator/venv-flag mistakes only show up at runtime). Bucket total = 10 -> medium.
